主要内容: On June 9, 2016, DISH Network Corporation announced that its subsidiary, DISH DBS Corporation, priced $2 billion aggregate principal amount of 10-year, 7.75% Senior Notes due 2026. The Notes will mature on July 1, 2026, with interest paid semi-annually on January 1 and July 1, starting from January 1, 2017. The offering is expected to close on June 13, 2016, subject to customary conditions. The Notes will be issued at 100% of par value and placed in a private placement under Rule 144A and Regulation S under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended. The net proceeds are intended for strategic transactions, including wireless and spectrum-related activities.
